comments.author: GrooveypenguinX
comments.body_html:
Lol you guys

1. That is my mod (head and voice selector)
2. It’s “sat in limbo” because they completely redid the character head selection screen. I was previously cloning the head/voice dropdowns and just shoving them into the overall screen and it “worked”.
3. It’s likely going to need a COMPLETE REWRITE in order to function again the way it did.

How do you change you head on an existing profile in the meantime?

You open the long lost heads of yojenkz/db/heads/ and open the .json file
You search for the head you would like to use
You copy it’s MongoID to the clipboard (the unique 24 character ID assigned to each head)

THEN

You open your profile.json
You search for the pmc customization section
You find the head id you currently have
You replace it with the head ID you want from yojenkz heads
